name: harness-antigravity
description: Harness for Antigravity CLI (agy) — /harness:* slash commands, persona agents, and the harness MCP server. agy shares the ~/.gemini/ home directory but is not configuration-compatible with Gemini CLI: MCP is declared in config/mcp_config.json (declaring it in settings.json is ignored). Sibling plugins exist for Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Codex.
